lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Hi, Hyunju! You look so happy today. What's up?
lines.ko: 안녕, 현주야! 오늘 정말 행복해 보인다. 무슨 일 있어?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I've finished my English study for thirty days.

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Yes, I studied every single day. I'm so happy.
lines.ko: 응, 하루도 빠짐없이 공부했어. 정말 행복해.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: That's amazing! How did you study?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I studied with an AI app. I made scripts and audio files.
lines.ko: AI 앱으로 공부했어. 대본이랑 음성 파일을 만들었어.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Cool! When did you listen to them?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I listened to them on the go.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Smart! What was the hardest part?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Most parts were very interesting, but the hardest part was when I didn't know the right English word.
lines.ko: 대부분 정말 재미있었는데, 딱 맞는 영어 단어를 모를 때가 제일 어려웠어.

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: After a few days of rest, I'm going to review what I studied.
lines.ko: 며칠 쉬고 나서, 공부한 걸 복습할 거야.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Great plan! Can you say one thing you learned?
lines.ko: 좋은 계획이다! 배운 거 하나만 말해 줄래?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Sure. I was a couch potato all weekend.
lines.ko: 그럼. 나 주말 내내 소파에서 뒹굴었어.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Ha ha! Me too! Will you keep studying?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Yes, I'll keep studying every day.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: I'm so proud of you, Hyunju! The end is the beginning!
lines.ko: 네가 정말 자랑스러워, 현주야! 끝은 곧 시작이야!
